tasks.title: Gravity in body axes
tasks.solution: g_body = R_nbᵀ·g_ned; the z component = g·cos φ·cos θ. Yaw doesn't affect it.

tasks.title: Lateral component
tasks.solution: The third row of R_nb (the third column of R_nbᵀ): (−sin θ, sin φ cos θ, cos φ cos θ)·g.
